entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I received. I'd like to return a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number to start?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 43 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. The online pictures made the color look like a bright red, but it's more of a maroon in person. It's a nice helmet, but it just doesn't match my bike.
I see. And is the item still in its original condition?
Yes, absolutely. The box is unopened. I looked at the color through the plastic window and knew it wasn't right, so I never even took it out.

Great, thank you for confirming. Since you are within the 90-day return window and the item is in new condition, I can approve this return for a full refund. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now.

That's fantastic, thank you. I do plan on ordering a different helmet from you. Since I'm having to go through the trouble of this return, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

Let me check for you. I see here that you are a VIP member with us, and we definitely appreciate your business. As a courtesy, I can add a 15% off coupon directly to your account. You can apply it at checkout on your next order.
Oh, 15% is perfect. That's very helpful, thank you for doing that. I'll place the new order as soon as we hang up.
You're very welcome. We want to ensure you have gear you love, and of course, your safety is always our top priority. The right gear helps with that. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
